name: kmcp-japan-bridge
description: 라쿠텐·야후쇼핑 상품 검색, 엔화 환율, 관부가세·배송비 포함 원가 계산, 스마트스토어 등록 초안. 환율·원가 계산은 키 없이 됩니다.
long_description:
라쿠텐·야후쇼핑 상품 검색, 엔화 환율, 관부가세·배송비 포함 원가 계산, 스마트스토어 등록 초안. 환율·원가 계산은 키 없이 됩니다.

K-MCP — 한국에서 일하는 AI 에이전트를 위한 오픈소스(MIT) MCP 서버 모음. 키는 이 컴퓨터에만 저장되고 각 플랫폼 API하고만 통신합니다.

tools.name: jp_search_rakuten
tools.description: Search Rakuten Ichiba (楽天市場) products by keyword: name, JPY price, shop, image, review score, stock, postage flag, item URL. 라쿠텐 상품을 검색합니다. Use to source Japanese items for a Korean listing; pass results to jp_landed_cost. Needs a keyword; RAKUTEN_APP_ID + RAKUTEN_ACCESS_KEY env.

tools.name: jp_search_yahoo
tools.description: Search Yahoo! JAPAN Shopping products by keyword: name, JPY price, seller, image, reviews, stock, free-shipping flag, URL. 1 request/sec limit. 야후재팬 쇼핑 상품을 검색합니다. Use alongside jp_search_rakuten to compare Japanese prices. Needs a keyword; YAHOO_JP_APP_ID env.

tools.name: jp_fx_rate
tools.description: Current JPY→KRW and USD→KRW mid-market rates (open.er-api.com, refreshed daily) for use in jp_landed_cost. Customs uses its own weekly rate; this is for estimates. 엔·달러 환율을 가져옵니다. Use before jp_landed_cost unless you already have rates. Needs nothing.

tools.name: jp_landed_cost
tools.description: Compute the full Korea landed cost of a Japanese item and a suggested Smart Store price: JPY→KRW, forwarder shipping, Korean customs (USD 150 de minimis, 간이세율 20% or duty+VAT), marketplace fees, target margin. Pure calculation, explains every step. 일본 상품의 한국 도착 원가와 권장 판매가를 계산합니다. Use after pickin…

tools.name: jp_listing_draft
tools.description: Build a Naver Smart Store listing draft for a Japanese item: Korean title/description slots, price from jp_landed_cost, images, origin 일본, plus the 해외구매대행 disclosures Korean law requires (shipping days, customs, no-return cases, 개인통관고유부호). Returns JSON for review — nothing is posted. 스마트스토어 등록 초안…
